items.raw_excerpt: On May 15, 1872, 1,500 workers marched in Hamilton, demanding the workday be reduced to nine hours, a movement that ultimately failed, but paved the way for laws that protect workers today.
items.summary_en: In 1872, workers in Hamilton marched for shorter workdays. The Nine Hour Movement failed but helped create today's worker protection laws.

items.title_en: Why more than 150 years later, Hamilton's Nine Hour Movement still matters

items.raw_excerpt: Younger generations in the Netherlands have generally ended up with more spending power and more wealth than their parents and grandparents did at the same age, according to national statistics office CBS. Home ownership, however, is an exception. The generation born between 1970 and 1985 is the most likely to own a home at age of life, CBS found. The number of 25- to 35-year-olds still living at home has also risen in recent years amid the housing shortage and...
items.summary_en: Dutch statistics office CBS found that younger generations in the Netherlands have more spending power than their parents at the same age. However, home ownership is an exception due to housing shortage. The number of young adults living at home has also risen in recent years.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 통계청 CBS에 따르면 젊은 세대는 같은 나이에 부모보다 지출 여력이 더 많습니다. 하지만 주택 부족으로 인해 주택 소유는 예외입니다. 또한 최근 몇 년간 집에 사는 젊은 성인의 수도 증가했습니다.
items.title_en: Younger generations richer than their parents in Netherlands

items.raw_excerpt: As the school year starts, the non-profit environmental association Green Communities Canada is continuing its efforts to implement pilot projects clearing regular student dropoff zones of cars.
items.summary_en: Green Communities Canada is running pilot projects to clear cars from school dropoff and pickup areas. The non-profit says safer streets encourage kids to walk and bike to school. Several Canadian cities are testing the car-free school zones approach.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 비영리 환경 단체 그린 커뮤니티즈 캐나다가 등하교 픽업·드롭오프 구역에서 자동차를 퇴출하는 시범 사업을 진행하고 있다. 해당 단체는 차 없는 거리가 아이들의 도보 등교와 자전거 이용을 촉진한다고 밝혔다. 캐나다 여러 도시에서 차 없는 학교 구역 시범 운영을 테스트하고 있다.
items.title_en: Canada pushes to remove cars from school dropoff zones

items.title_original: It's back to school season. Here's why there's a push to get rid of cars at dropoff and pickup

items.raw_excerpt: The inter-municipal company Águas do Alto Alentejo (AAA) announced it has submitted applications for EU funding totalling approximately €9.4 million since January.
items.summary_en: A Portuguese inter-municipal water company has applied for about 9.4 million euros in EU funding since January. The money will be used to renew water supply equipment in the Alto Alentejo region. The company Águas do Alto Alentejo manages water services for municipalities in that area.

items.title_en: Portugal region applies for EU funding to renew water supply

items.raw_excerpt: In the wake of the bungled Spirit of Tasmania replacement project, ferry operator TT-Line says it expects to stay in debt for an estimated 26 years.
items.summary_en: TT-Line, which runs the Spirit of Tasmania ferry service, says it expects to remain in debt until 2052. The company blames the failed replacement project for the old ferry. An inquiry heard that the debt will last an estimated 26 years.
items.summary_ko: 태즈메이니아에서 스피릿 오브 태즈메이니아 페리를 운영하는 TT-Line은 2052년까지 약 26년간 빚을 갚아야 할 것으로 전망된다. 기존 페리 교체 사업의 실패로 인해 이 같은 상황이 초래됐다. 조사에서 이같이 밝혀졌다.
items.title_en: Tasmania ferry operator will carry debt for 26 years
items.title_ko: 호주 태즈메이니아 페리 운영사, 2052년까지 빚 지속 예상
items.title_original: Spirit of Tasmania ferry operator to be in debt until 2052, inquiry hears

items.raw_excerpt: Steven Bonilla-Graham-Darby says he is 'traumatised' by the abuse directed at his family.
items.summary_en: Two dads received hateful messages after sharing photos of their wedding online. Steven Bonilla-Graham-Darby said the abuse has left his family traumatised. The story highlights the discrimination same-sex parents still face in England.

items.raw_excerpt: In recent weeks, many Americans in France have received letters from their US banks warning them that they may have to close their accounts due to a new EU banking requirements - we asked specialists in financial planning and tax to explain the implications.
items.summary_en: Many Americans living in France have received letters from their US banks warning that accounts may be closed. This is due to new EU banking requirements. Financial specialists explain the implications for affected individuals.

items.raw_excerpt: A passport renewal often involves getting a new document with different numbers and details on it, but does that mean foreigners in Spain also have to get a new residency document as well every time?
items.summary_en: Foreigners in Spain sometimes wonder if a new passport means they also need a new residency card. Spanish authorities say a residence card does not automatically change when you renew your passport. You can usually keep your existing card until it expires.
items.summary_ko: 스페인에 거주하는 외국인이 여권을 갱신하면 거주 카드도 다시 발급받아야 하는지 궁금해하는 사람들이 많습니다. 스페인 당국에 따르면 여권을 갱신해도 거주 카드는 자동으로 변경되지 않습니다. 일반적으로 만료 전까지 기존 카드를 계속 사용할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Renewing a Spanish Residency Card After a New Passport
items.title_ko: 스페인 여권 갱신 시 거주 카드 재발급 필요 여부

items.raw_excerpt: More than 3,300 people swam 2km through Amsterdam’s canals on Sunday and raised a record €3 million for research into the muscle-wasting disease ALS. Last year’s event brought in just under €1.73 million. Swimmers set off from the Keizersgracht in groups every few minutes and finished at the Marineterrein, next to the maritime museum. A shorter 750-metre swim for children and less experienced swimmers took place earlier in the day. Among the participants were 12 people who have ALS, some...
